subject: RRPP 0.6.2 and geomorph 3.3.2 available on CRAN

messages.subject: RRPP 0.6.2 and geomorph 3.3.2 available on CRAN
parts:
Colleagues, 

 

We would like to announce that updates to both RRPP and geomorph are now available on CRAN.  With these versions, one may notice slight differences in the point estimates of effect sizes (Z-scores) returned from certain tests, due to the inclusion of Box-Cox transformations when estimating empirically-derived effect sizes.

 

As always, this, and other changes, are detailed in the help files and the News pages.

 

Happy computing!

 

Dean, Mike and the rest of the geomorph team (Antigoni and Erica)

 

Dr. Dean C. Adams

Director of Graduate Education, EEB Program
